Stage.LogText: {=sp_gt3_s1_log}Calradia's obstacles have been cleared in blood. Travel to {TunekSehri_Link} to meet the Blind Master {KorUsta_Link}, founder of the Shadow Roost, and choose the ultimate fate of the realm.
{=sp_gt3_s2_kirikkukla_log}You set the roost ablaze! {KorUsta_Link}'s 40 fanatic guards {FanatikMuhafizlar_Link} surround you in fury. Annihilate them and break the chains of the cult!

{=sp_gt3_s_bas_efendi_log}The Blind Master's breath ceased under your fingers. The Shadow Master Ring now gleams upon your hand. While Calradia's kings sit pompously upon their thrones, each morning they will wake to a raven feather beneath their pillow, reminding them who truly rules Calradia from the dark.

{=sp_gt3_s_kirik_kukla_log}The roost burned to ashes beneath the mountain stars. You shattered the puppeteer's strings and buried the secret order forever. Calradia is free of the Shadow Roost, and you earned 75,000 denars and the renown of a true liberator.

{=sp_gt3_s_kaos_log}You chose absolute chaos. By releasing the forged decrees across every faction, war horns now echo from every mountain peak. Blood will wash the lands, and above the slaughter, your name will be whispered with dread. You claimed 150,000 denars from the ensuing collapse.

DialogNode.Text: {=sp_gt3_dost_p_entry}So you have finally come out of the shadows, {Dost.Name}.
{=sp_gt3_dost_a1}Ever since you refused to cut down that traitor artisan, my eyes have never left you... You will pay for your betrayal with your life!
{=sp_gt3_dost_p1_defiant}Your surveillance ends here, {Dost.Name}. The Motherland was never your puppet stage!
{=sp_gt3_dost_p1_cunning}You speak of betrayal, yet you manufactured wars for profit and called it patriotism.
{=sp_gt3_dost_p1_prag}Then let us end this. No more games, no more false ravens. Come at me, if you dare.
{=sp_gt3_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_gt3_dost_a2}Profit? No, you blind fool! ORDER! While kings played their games of crowns, I kept Calradia from tearing itself apart! And you, you threw away everything for the word of a runaway artisan and a pack of shadow fanatics!
{=sp_gt3_dost_p2_accuse}The Black Ledger tells a different story. Village massacres under false banners. Grain hoards built on fabricated famines. This is your 'order'.
{=sp_gt3_dost_p2_question}If you truly served the realm, why did you need me to kill your own artisan? What was he going to expose?
{=sp_gt3_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_gt3_dost_a3}He saw too much! A craftsman playing at philosophy, imagining himself the conscience of the realm. I built this network with blood and sleepless decades, no artisan's sentimentality was going to unravel it! And now you stand in the threshold of my roost, blade in hand, thinking yourself a hero? You are nothing but the last loose thread I must trim.
{=sp_gt3_dost_p3_fight}Then trim it, {Dost.Name}. Or die trying!
{=sp_gt3_dost_p3_negotiate}{Dost.Name}. Stand down. You are outnumbered and your network is exposed. This ends without more bloodshed.
{=sp_gt3_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_gt3_dost_a4}Trial? Ha! I taught those council lords everything they know about surviving a trial. But perhaps... perhaps there is a final move on this board. Forgive me, old friend. Some games have only one ending.
{=sp_gt3_dost_p4_final}It is over, {Dost.Name}. The roost falls with you.
{=sp_gt3_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=sp_gt3_dlg1_p}I have come to face the master of the roost.

{=sp_gt3_dlg1}Step forward, little pigeon... I cannot see your eyes, but I hear the rhythm of your stride. The blood of {Dost.Name}, the scent of burning ledgers, and the cold steel of ambition clinging to your mantle.

{=sp_gt3_dlg1}Step forward, little pigeon... I cannot see your eyes, but I hear the rhythm of your stride. The blood of {Dost.Name}, the scent of burning ledgers, and the cold steel of ambition clinging to your mantle.
{=sp_gt3_dlg_p1_inq}So you are the Blind Master, the hidden phantom who birthed the Scavenger Pigeons from the shadows.
{=sp_gt3_dlg_p1_angry}Breathe that scent deeply, old man. It is the butcher's bill for your decades of conspiracy and deceit.
{=sp_gt3_dlg_p1_prag}I didn't scale this fortress for poetic metaphors. {Dost.Name} is dead, and the master ciphers are mine. What is your will?
{=sp_gt3_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_gt3_dlg_u_philosophy}Deceit? No, little bird... Harmony! Calradia's monarchs are vain beasts who would drown this continent in blood for a patch of barren soil. The Shadow Roost gives their bloodlust a script. We whisper, we forge, we harvest their gold, and in return, we keep humanity from self-annihilation.
{=sp_gt3_dlg_u_peace_query}You justify starvation and border raids in the name of peace. How many innocent lives were sacrificed to write your 'script'?
{=sp_gt3_dlg_u_selfdeceit}You are a master of illusions who ended up deceiving yourself. You didn't stop wars; you merely industrialized them.
{=sp_gt3_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_gt3_dlg_u_script_reveal}Ten thousand died in our border clashes so ten million wouldn't burn in a continental apocalypse! Do you think kingdoms survive on virtue? Calradia breathes because the Shadow Roost operates in the dark. Without a puppeteer, the realm descends into madness.
{=sp_gt3_dlg_u_power_claim}Then the seat of the puppeteer belongs to someone stronger. Your vision is obsolete, Master.
{=sp_gt3_dlg_u_burn_threat}The world doesn't need your false gods in the dark. The realm deserves the truth, even if it burns in fire.
{=sp_gt3_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=sp_gt3_dlg_u_final_prompt}Speak your verdict, little pigeon. Calradia's crowns tremble in silence for your choice.
{=sp_gt3_dlg2}You forgot the first rule you taught me, Master: 'The sharpest beak cracks the oldest roost.' From now on, I give the orders! (Poison the Blind Master & Claim the Shadow Throne)
{=sp_gt3_dlg3}You are no mastermind; you are a sewer rat lurking in the dark! No motherland, no honor, only lies and slaughter. This roost burns tonight! (Torch the Roost & Slaughter the Fanatics)

{=sp_gt3_dlg4}The world does not seek order, Master. The world hungers for fire! I have dispatched the forged decrees to the monarchs of Calradia. At dawn, war horns shall sound! (Unleash Continental War)
{=sp_gt3_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=sp_gt3_dlg_fanatic_intro}Heretic! You defied the Blind Master and betrayed the Roost! Feed the crows with your flesh!
{=sp_gt3_dlg_fanatic_p1}Your master was a madman, and his roost burns today! (Fight)
{=sp_gt3_dlg_fanatic_p2}The Roost's lies die with you! (Fight)
